title: Kasi Spotlight: Gogo Catering
body: What started as cooking for neighbours' weddings in a Meadowlands backyard is now the name families call for umgidi, funerals and graduations across Soweto.

spotlight.story: What started as cooking for neighbours' weddings in a Meadowlands backyard is now the name families call for umgidi, funerals and graduations across Soweto. Every pot of samp and beef stew is still made the way her mother taught her, and every order still comes in on WhatsApp.
spotlight.quote: When you feed people at their happiest and their hardest moments, you become part of the family.
